moments.subtitle: What Kubernetes is

composition.aestheticNotes: Neo-brutalist card with hard-offset shadow lands center-frame, oversized display text in amber primary. Stark asymmetric composition with thick accent border creates bold first impression.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#0c0a05 fills entire frame. primary:#d4820a on hard-offset card background. accent:#f5c842 on word 'Kubernetes' highlight sweep and card shadow. text:#fefaf0 on all typography.

beat1.description: Card slams in from below with spring-snappy easing, hard shadow appears on landing. Display text word-by-word slams cascade in stagger.
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-15: card enters, shadow visible. Frames 10-20: text cascade completes.

holdWindow.description: Card breathes with subtle scale pulse, highlight sweep completes beneath Kubernetes word.
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 20-50: card holds center, breathe scale 1.0→1.012→1.0

moments.emphasis: The word KUBERNETES lands with visual authority, establishing this as a technical deep-dive.
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-12: hard-offset card translates from +40px below to center, boxShadow '7px 7px 0 #f5c842' visible as it settles, opacity 0→1 via spring-snappy. Frames 8-20: display text 'KUBERNETES' enters word-by-word via T1 slam cascade, each word scale 0→1.18→1.0. Frames 20-50: card breathes scale 1.0→1.012→1.0, accent underline sweeps beneath 'KUBERNETES' via T3 highlight sweep width 0→100%. Frames 50: snap-cut exit. Colors: bg #0c0a05, card primary #d4820a, accent #f5c842 on shadow and underline, text #fefaf0.

moments.subtitle: What Kubernetes automates

composition.aestheticNotes: Clean stacked reveal of three automation pillars (deployment, scaling, management) with soft radial bloom behind each. Generous negative space, calm cinematic hold.
composition.colorNotes: bg:#1c120d fills full frame. primary:#8b5e3c on pillar labels. accent:#e8c9a0 on keyword highlights and radial bloom centers. text:#f5ede0 on body text at 85% opacity.

beat1.description: Display text 'AUTOMATES' wipes in from left via masked text reveal. Three pillar rows cascade in with 120ms stagger, each slide-in from left.
beat1.timingHint: Frames 0-22: display wipe reveals. Frames 15-45: pillars cascade in stagger.

holdWindow.description: Each pillar breathes independently, warm radial bloom pulses gently behind each. Pill badges enter after pillars settle.
holdWindow.durationHint: Frames 45-111: pillars breathe scale 1.0→1.015→1.0, bloom opacity oscillates 0.38→0.2→0.38

moments.emphasis: The three pillars (deployment, scaling, management) visualize what Kubernetes automates, with warm bloom creating approachable tech feel.
moments.animationPrompt: Frames 0-22: display 'AUTOMATES' reveals via masked text wipe, mask width 100%→0 ease-out-expo. Frames 15-45: three pillar rows 'Deployment', 'Scaling', 'Management' enter via L5 stacked reveal, translateX -30→0 spring-snappy, opacity 0→1, stagger 120ms per row. Frames 45-111: all pillars breathe scale 1.0→1.015→1.0 in unison, G1 warm radial bloom pulses behind each (accent #e8c9a0, opacity 0.38→0.2→0.38). Pill badge 'containers' bounces in at frame 60 via G8 notification badge. Frames 111: shrink-fade exit. Colors: bg #1c120d, primary #8b5e3c on pillars, accent #e8c9a0 on bloom, text #f5ede0.
